Hard constraints (must follow exactly):
Deliver the entire codebase. No simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, todo, simulated, or fake content. Provide all files in full, unshortened, production-ready code. No comments or extra messages outside the required output format.
Keep everything as a root-level LLM project with its own non‑transformer architecture, runtime, hardware, tokenizer, optimizer, training/inference pipeline, and formal security proofs, plus full build and deployment automation.

Use only the output format defined. Do not add any narrative, explanation, or extra text.
Target architecture (must implement):
Core model: Non‑transformer hybrid composed Provide clean module boundaries and interop.
Numerics: Zig-based TensorCore (SIMD‑optimized matmul, layernorm, softmax, spectral ops), exposed to Julia bindings where needed.

Datasets: Do not include training datasets.

No other text, comments, banners, or explanations. Never omit or truncate files.
